items.problem: MainPage.xaml.cs became duplicated/corrupted after an edit that replaced a leading block while the original UWP body remained appended, causing a build failure.
items.evidence: session-log turns 39-40: 'The file has duplicate content — the original UWP body was appended after my replacement. I need to rewrite the whole file cleanly'.
items.covered_clearly_at: N/A — this is an edit-mechanics mistake by the agent, not a migration-pattern topic. The agent detected it immediately and rewrote the file via a here-string, recovering to a passing build.
items.why_no_skill_change: A capable model on re-run would apply the edit correctly or self-correct as it did here; there is no general migration rule to encode. Adding 'don't corrupt files during edits' guidance would be noise.
